name: wunderlust
description: Hand-picked creative cards for design, motion and AI: award-winning sites, animation and 3D libraries, UI components and AI tools, each with the one idea worth exploring.

interface.longDescription:
Wunderlust is a hand-picked, always-growing stash of creative sites, skills, UI components and AI tools for people who design and build: award-winning websites, motion and animation libraries, 3D and WebGL tools, UI components, inspiration galleries, AI tools, agents and coding skills.

Every card is checked and written up by hand in plain English: what it is, what it is for, the one idea worth exploring in it, typical uses, benefits and caveats, with the official link.

Ask for ideas while you design or build. Search the stash in your own words or by category, tag, design pattern or editorial pick; read the full write-up of a card with its caveats; find similar cards; get a random selection for inspiration; show chosen cards in the chat; or read a collection someone shared from Wunderlust as a brief. Answers with two or more cards include a board link that opens them side by side in the browser, with video.

It only reads the public stash. It needs no account and never changes anything.
capabilities: Search hand-picked sites, skills and AI tools by text, category, tag or pattern
Read the full write-up of a card, with its caveats and official link
Find cards similar to one you like
Show chosen cards in the chat, with cover and preview video
Read a collection someone shared from Wunderlust
